page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 12 physical cores using an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 48.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It has no local storage and does not include any GPUs. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate average multi-core capabilities alongside weaker single-core execution. The single-core Geekbench score of 905.0 and stress-ng single-core performance of 1106.18 are positioned in the lower tiers, reflecting the older CPU architecture. However, multi-core benchmarks show moderate capacity, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 4589.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 10042.2. Memory bandwidth is stable, reaching 491.92 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 56.47 GB/sec for uncached large blocks.

This instance is suited for workloads that benefit from multi-threaded execution but do not require high single-thread performance or local storage. Suitable applications include moderate database operations, software compilation, and basic web serving. It can also handle light language model inference, processing 115.95 tokens per second on a small 135M model, though performance drops significantly on larger models. Given its dedicated resource allocation and older hardware profile, it offers a stable, cost-efficient option for legacy enterprise applications and general-purpose multi-threaded workloads.
